description: NSW Police recorded crime statistics by postcode, suburb, offence category, and month.
source_format: wide CSV melted to one event per (postcode, suburb, offence_category, month)

time_object.timestamp: YYYY-MM-01T00:00:00Z  (first day of the reported month)

field_map.count: Wide monthly column (e.g. 'Jan 1995') → integer (incidents that month)

notes: Source file: ~/Desktop/raw_housing_data/cleaned_crime_data.csv. Each wide row is exploded into ~372 events (Jan 1995 – Dec 2025). Null / empty monthly cells are skipped.
